scope: Consolidated user requirements; coverage and approval are separate records.
target: Consistent modern shaded humanoid sprites for a top-down RPG; explicit native resolution and intended display scale.

current_provider_policy.preferred: built-in OpenAI ImageGen plus deterministic and manual editing

quality.working_target: At least8/10 for relevant appearance and motion dimensions on each required reviewed clip

equipment: Interchangeable weapon/accessory tracks need compatible body motion, measured grips and occlusion; not an arbitrary object pasted onto an unarmed punch.
pixel_lab_boundary: Observed/recovered client subsets and catalogs do not recover private weights, training, hidden prompts, constructors or all server behavior.
acceptance_state: See docs/STATUS.md and source-bound reviews; this requirements file assigns no clip acceptance.
